item.title: Blue Mountain Pulls Away Late to Defeat Schuylkill Haven, 64-54, in League Quarterfinals
item.description: A tight three-quarter battle turned into a late Blue Mountain surge Saturday night as the Eagles pulled away in the fourth quarter to defeat Schuylkill Haven, 64-54, in the Schuylkill League Boys Basketball Quarterfinals at Martz Hall.With the game hanging in the balance entering the final period, Blue Mountain outscored the Hurricanes 25-19 over the last eight minutes to secure the win and advance to the league semifinals.The contest featured momentum swings throughout the first half.
